item.title: LOT-085: composer BBCode toolbar and insertion engine
item.body:
LOT-085
Closes #177
Claim: cloud/lot-085

**Problem.** The reply composer (LOT-084) is a bare editor: no BBCode buttons, no colours, no clipboard link helper; legacy has all three.

**Change.** Ports legacy `BBCodeTag`, `ReplyTextInsertionEngine`, `ReplyTextColor` and the clipboard confirmation (HFR-010) (origin/master 21173e7, cited in `docs/lots/LOT-085-composer-toolbar.md`):
- `ReplyTextInsertionEngine`: pure wrap / url / splitQuote / insert, ranges clamped, caret always returned.
- `ComposerFormattingModel` (`@Observable @MainActor`): edits the composer text, requests the caret (`cursorRevision`), clipboard alerts behind `ClipboardReading`.
- `FormattingToolbar` + `TextEditor(selection:)` in `ReplyComposerView`: caret placed from the engine result, never at the end.
No new dependency, no HFR fact beyond legacy code. splitQuote and smiley `insert` are engine-only (no button in this lot).

**Tests.** `ReplyTextInsertionEngineTests` (selection / none / emoji UTF-16 / clamping / url / splitQuote), `ComposerFormattingModelTests` (caret, palette, clipboard accept/decline/reuse/non-http). Not run locally (app target, CI builds); SwiftLint clean.

**Mac check needed**
- [ ] Each tag with and without selection: caret lands after / between tags, never jumps to the end (also mid-text).
- [ ] Palette: open, pick colour, back; keyboard stays up.
- [ ] Lien with selection + copied URL: alert Oui / Non; same clipboard not offered twice; paste prompt acceptable.
- [ ] Empty selection + copied text: alert wraps the text.
- [ ] Toolbar above keyboard on iPhone and iPad; light, dark, Dynamic Type XL; draft autosave still works after toolbar edits.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CEXoVitAHtha5AtXfc)_

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a formatting toolbar to the reply composer with BBCode formatting and color options.
  * Toolbar actions wrap selected text or insert tags at the cursor. With confirmation, clipboard text can be inserted for formatting, and HTTP(S) clipboard links can be used for URL tags. The editor restores focus after toolbar actions.
* **Documentation**
  * Added composer toolbar documentation and updated migration notes to describe quote-splitting support in the insertion engine; a quote-splitting button is not yet available.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title "LOT-085: composer BBCode toolbar and insertion engine" names the main change: a BBCode formatting toolbar and a text insertion engine for the reply composer. The changeset adds ComposerFormattingModel, FormattingToolbar, ReplyTextInsertionEngine, SystemClipboard, their tests, and LOT-085 documentation, which matches the title. The title includes a ticket identifier, which is a minor addition, but it remains specific and readable.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Direct link: `#177` (LOT-085). No parent or sibling context supplied. No closed or contextual items. Objective 1 [`#177`]: Pure insertion engine. Implemented in App/SwiftHFR/Composer/ReplyTextInsertionEngine.swift: wrapWithBBCode, wrapSelectionWithURL, splitQuote, insert, and clamped. Each edit returns an explicit UTF-16 caret location. The current file read confirms that ComposerFormattingModel.commit sets selectedRange from result.cursorLocationUTF16. Objective 2 [`#177`]: Legacy tag set and colours. Implemented by the BBCode tag list, the 16-colour ReplyTextColor palette, and FormattingToolbar (tag buttons, palette, back action). Objective 3 [`#177`]: Clipboard link after confirmation (HFR-010). ComposerFormattingModel.tap builds a .link pending action when the selection is non-empty and the clipboard holds an HTTP(S) URL. acceptPending inserts the link. declinePending applies plain URL tags. The alert in ReplyComposerView uses "Oui"/"Non". A used change count is not offered again after acceptance. Non-HTTP text is not offered (isHTTP check). Objective 4 [`#177`]: No cursor jump to the end after an insertion. commit sets selectedRange to the engine caret and increments cursorRevision. ReplyComposerView moves the TextEditor selection to min(engine offset, text length) on each revision change. The only fallback to text end is for an invalid or stale selection reported by the editor before a tap. That fallback is not an insertion result, so it does not violate this objective. It is noted as a residual edge. Objective 5 [`#177`]: Tests. ReplyTextInsertionEngineTests and ComposerFormattingModelTests exist under App/SwiftHFRTests/Composer/. Summaries report selection, no-selection, cursor, UTF-16, clamping, URL, splitQuote, palette, and clipboard cases. Test bodies were not read in this review. Each test shown to fail without the change is not verifiable here. Objective 6 [`#177`]: `@Observable` `@MainActor` view logic. ComposerFormattingModel is declared `@MainActor` `@Observable`. ClipboardReading isolates the pasteboard for tests. Confirmed in the file read. Objective 7 [`#177`]: French UI strings. Confirmed in the file read: "Insérer « … » avec … ?" and related alert text. Objective 8 [`#177`]: No new dependency. The change set adds no package or dependency entry. HFR facts are cited to legacy origin/master 21173e7 (AnswerView.swift) in code comments and docs/lots/LOT-085-composer-toolbar.md. The legacy source is not available to this review, so the citations are not independently verified. Not counted as coding requirements, and not verified here: xcodebuild build test on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad (iOS 27.0), the 'App build + tests' CI job, light, dark, and Dynamic Type XL checks, and the Mac checks in the PR description. The PR states that local tests were not run. These outcomes are not evidence in this review. Repository diff for ReplyComposerView.swift was unavailable (changed blobs missing from checkout). Its caret wiring is assessed from the PR summary only.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** Changes reviewed against `#177` scope (legacy parity, no FEAT, no new dependency): - ReplyTextInsertionEngine.swift, ComposerFormattingModel.swift, FormattingToolbar.swift, ReplyComposerView.swift, SystemClipboard.swift: directly implement `#177` objectives (engine, toolbar, clipboard confirmation, caret placement, UIKit clipboard adapter for ClipboardReading). - Engine-only splitQuote and snippet insert (ComposerFormattingModel.splitQuoteAtCaret, insert): no toolbar button in this PR. The PR description discloses this. They are legacy engine behaviours, ported and tested, and add no user-facing feature. This fits 'ported from the legacy behaviour (cited)' and 'no FEAT'. - Tests (ReplyTextInsertionEngineTests, ComposerFormattingModelTests): support the implemented objectives. - App/README.md, docs/lots/LOT-085-composer-toolbar.md, docs/migration/GAP-LEGACY-VS-SWIFT.md: documentation of the same change and of its gap status. Not feature scope. - ReplyComposerView.swift edits: toolbar, alert, and editor caret wiring. The summary does not identify unrelated changes to the existing smiley picker or draft code. The file-level diff could not be read, so this rests on the summary. No change was found that is unrelated to `#177`.
